title: x402 Treasury Experiments
description:
Supplementary dataset for pre-registered measurements of the cost and friction of converting accumulated L2 USDC micropayment revenue into spendable fiat. Both experiments were sealed in git before execution (protocol, operator runbook, tranche ladder), run in a single pass, and committed regardless of outcome; every execution deviation is recorded verbatim in the repository METHODOLOGY.

Experiment 1: usdc-fiat-sweep-api (v1)

Eight pre-registered tranches (USD 1 to the full balance; USD 157.25908 total) converted to USD via the Coinbase Advanced Trade convert API from the production receiver wallet on Base mainnet.

  • Headline finding: convert fee quoted and charged USD 0.00; realized fee 0.00%; spread 0%; every tranche converted 1:1 to fiat.
  • Only realized cost: Base gas, 0.00000654 ETH from a 0.00014 ETH funding float (on-chain transfer values verified at wei precision).
  • Send-to-spendable latency (uncontaminated credit timestamps only): 236 s, 263 s, 5 s; the five earlier credit timestamps are recovery-time artifacts of a disclosed mid-run remediation and are excluded from latency findings.

Experiment 2: usdc-fiat-sweep-v2

Independent-exchange replication on Kraken (USDC/USD order book, stablecoin fee schedule) at x402 micro-receipt volumes (USD 5–20), plus a Coinbase issuer-rail continuity arm.

  • Headline finding: realized fee was exactly the advertised 0.20% taker fee on both executed USD sell tranches (USD 10 and the USD 91 residue); spread +0.005% against the observed mid; realized slippage −0.01% (better than top-of-book, where the fixed 5 USDC ordermin dominates).
  • Continuity: Coinbase convert reproduced v1's finding — quoted and realized fee USD 0.00, 1:1 USDC/USD, on both commits.
  • Negative result with cause: the CAD disbursement arm (cad-20, cad-eft) is recorded as not_executed_below_minimum, not missing data: the sealed residue-sweep formula arithmetically consumes the entire spendable balance before the fixed-size cad-20 tranche can run.
  • Execution caveat: every executed v2 tranche was recovery-assisted after four latent script defects crashed the pass mid-flight, so all records carry is_latency_valid = false; fee and price endpoints come verbatim from executed fills and are unaffected.

Contents

  • experiments/ — sealed protocols, operator runbooks, run records, verbatim raw API artifacts and transaction receipts
  • results/, METHODOLOGY.md, DATA_DICTIONARY.md — reports, recorded deviations, record schema
  • figures/ — frozen figure recipes and rendered figures

The operator maintains the production site whose revenue is measured; findings are about this measurement, not any product.
